name: Jiangsu Allfavor Intelligent Circuits Technology CO.,Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Allfavor Intelligent Circuits Technology CO.,Ltd engages in research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards. It offers high frequency high speed board, multifunctional metal substrate, thick copper plate, flexible board, rigid-flex board, and HDI boards. The company's products are used in communications, automobiles, power, electronics, communications, medical, military and other fields. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
